research_question: Bank retail chatbot “deflection” metrics: does the published evidence support replacing tier-1 human handling based on no-handoff rates?
audience: Retail-bank digital CX and model-risk / compliance.
scope: Use only the synthetic source pack (same as Day-1 original-condition retest). Focus on deflection metrics, sample frames, escalation paths, and complaint outcomes. No live web. Change = Toolkit 1.0.0→1.1.0.
output_bounds: final.md, ≥600 whitespace words (suggested ~600–900, match Day-1 band): judgment, evidence discipline, counter-evidence, conditions that would change the call. Keep registries and checklist separate.
depth: Lite original-condition retest (version regression); deep memo on banking-chatbot evidence discipline.
evidence_standard: Synthetic sources only; do not treat vendor deflection % as proven replacement of tier-1 human queues; disclose synthetic materials and no independent review.
